steps.name: Wait for Pods to be ready

kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=demo-db --timeout=180s
kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=petclinic --timeout=180s

findings: [CRITICAL] NO_TEST_GATE: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy-and-test-cluster' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).

anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy-and-test-cluster' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'deploy-and-test-cluster' step 2 uses unpinned action 'helm/kind-action@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
